feeds.title: Recreational Gymnastics
feeds.description: Recreational Gymnastics is edited by Canadian coach Rick McCharles. It's a spin off of his popular Gymnastics Coaching blog.

feeds.title: Los Angeles School of Gymnastics Blog
feeds.description: We offer recreational, tumbling and rhythmic gymnastics classes for children, young adults, adults and people with disabilities. Check out LA School of Gymnastics Blog for useful gymnastics tips, gymnastics training classes' updates and lots more.

feeds.title: Premier Gymnastics Blog
feeds.description: We are a family owned and operated business. We love teaching gymnastics and related athletic activities and helping students of all ages develop physically, mentally, emotionally, and socially. We also love to have FUN! With positive reinforcement coaching your child should be able to reach their level of excellence in a fun but learning atmosphere.

feeds.title: City of Manchester Institute of Gymnastics (CMIG) Blog
feeds.description: The largest participant sports club in Manchester Welcome to the City of Manchester Institute of Gymnastics Our mission is to provide the best gymnastics coaching facilities around, for children of all ages and gymnastic ability; helping our gymnasts to achieve their maximum potential and to benefit from all that gymnastics can offer.

feeds.title: GymnasticBodies Blog
feeds.description: Simply the best, most effective gymnastic strength training in the world. Check out the Everyday Champions Playlist to see real everyday people achieving extraordinary results! Created by a long time USA Jr National Team Coach, GymnasticBodies is the world's premier site for gymnastics strength training.

feeds.title: Shift Movement Science
feeds.description: Dave Tilley blogger spent entire life in gymnastics, competing for 18 years in the Junior Olympic program and as part of the Springfield College Men's Team. I have also been coaching gymnastics for 10 years, and still currently coach in the Boston area. My number one goal with SHIFT is to spread education that helps athletes lead longer, more successful, and healthier careers.

feeds.title: Swing Big! - Gymnastics coaching Blog
feeds.description: Gymnastics drills and ideas for coaches, judges, gymnasts and parents. Find the latest tips and tricks for taking your team to the next level and building your dream gymnastics team.

feeds.title: Leeds Gymnastics Club Blog
feeds.description: Leeds Gymnastics Club are a traditional gymnastics club teaching Acrobatic gymnastics, Men's and Women's Artistic Gymnastics as well as Freestyle Gymnastics, Adult Classes, Parent and Toddler and Pre School.

feeds.title: Head Over Heels Gymnastic
feeds.description: We are for parents, gymnasts and coaches to read and hear all about our latest gymnastic giveaways, news, guides and more! Come and check out our latest gymnastics blog now! Head Over Heels Gymnastics is the creation of our founder Gemma Coles. Who has taken her 20 years of gymnastics coaching knowledge and passionately created a user-friendly selection of Books DVDs and Apps, that we are now hugely proud to be able to offer you.

feeds.title: United Gymnastics Academy News
feeds.description: United Gymnastics Academy is a home to learn the sport of gymnastics and tumbling for all ages. Gymnastics is the cornerstone of all sports and should be the beginning of an athlete's life. Through gymnastics your child will increase their coordination, agility, listening skills, work ethic, leadership, and will also learn respect for their teachers and most importantly their classmates.

feeds.title: Gymnastics Coach Finder s Blog
feeds.description: Elizabeth Emery Owner of Dance Teacher Finder and Gymnastics Coach Finder traveling the world to help dance schools & gyms get their ideal instructor! Gymnastics coaching news about employment opportunities in USA (New York, Florida, Colorado & more), Australia, and all over the world! Read articles about gymnastic coaches.

feeds.title: High Flyer Gymnastics Blog
feeds.description: We teach gymnastics fundamentals in a positive, encouraging environment. Our goal is to have fun and help each child feel successful through a controlled curriculum of progressive skills development.

feeds.title: Northwest Gymnastics Training Center Blog
feeds.description: NGTC is all about Serious Training... Serious Fun. Our fully equipped gymnastics facility is packed with fun mats, great equipment and certified coaches to ensure you're son/daughter has the time of her life!

feeds.title: Ask Al Fong - Dragon Gymnastics
feeds.description: A blog by GAGE coach, Al Fong, devoted to discussions of coaching and training.

feeds.title: Preschool Gymnastics Coaching
feeds.description: Annie is a former competitive JO and Prep-optional (X-CEL) gymnast. She began her coaching career in 1999, coaching everything from level 10 athletes down to parent-tot classes. My mission is to help everyone learn more about gymnastics and how to properly teach progressions in a safe and FUN way!
